name: Clukay
quote: The light that shatters the night, and the death raging in one's heart.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. The affairs of the day have been arranged. There's no better time than now for you to work.

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: The sun's about to set. If we are to make a move, then now would be the time. Take me with you. I'll make short work of our target.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: There's often ample time for personal matters after dinner. You can leave any work to me. You'll be hard pressed to find someone better.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: Professor, this time frame isn't suited for anything other than a surprise attack. You can leave it to me if there is anything you need.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Professor, please look over the plans again. Since I am already by your side, the only remaining factors on the battlefield are our sources of intelligence and when we make our move. Decisions made in the heat of the moment will only bring defeat.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: The matters that StateSec handles aren't anything to scoff at... the dirty work comes up too, and there's no end to it. However, if it's your order, then no task is too great.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: Are you observing the other Dolls? You've got the very best standing right here, you know.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: I'm going to organize my liquor cabinet. Want to see my collection? One rule—for your eyes only.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Who else have you touched like this?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: There are tools that may deliver us victory in there, but they may not be as stable as I am. If you give them any more attention, they might just explode.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: What is it?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Understood.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: We meet again, "Professor". I am your finest choice for the predicament at hand. You can call me Clukay.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: Observe. I'll outdo all of them.

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Yes, like that... I'll make them only fit to chase behind me.

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: I've already achieved perfection. Now, to surpass perfection.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Order received.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: You'll see what I'm made of.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Perish quietly. I'll be the victor here.

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: These displays are nothing new to me.

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I am all you need.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: For me... to lose to something like this!

voices.label: Oath
voices.text: I have won this battle, and you are both mine conferrer and the spoil of war. Come... bestow glory unto me. This laurel I shall carry upon me, till the day I die.

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: Happy New Year, Professor. How has the past year been to you? I'll bring you nothing but the most immaculate of results this forthcoming year.

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Everyone's talking about chocolates. <cmdr>, if we just share a box of liquor chocolates, then there'll be no chance of getting drunk, right? Here, this is your half. Your name's on it... so you'd better not go sharing it with anyone else, understood?

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text: A holiday for the gathering of those who were once separate... how adamant. To wait countless days every year for this day, one must have someone they value greatly indeed. <cmdr>, who would you hold in such high regard?

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: Ghosts are nothing to be afraid of, so we'll just move as we always do. This outfit? I... I'm just getting into the spirit of the holiday.

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Christmas is always this raucous and hectic... all waiting for Santa Claus, huh? You should look forward to what I've prepared for you instead. I have no doubt that it'll be without equal.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Happy Birthday, <cmdr>. This day is the reason we are able to meet and walk alongside each other. Let's celebrate properly today. There's no better occasion.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text:
What each individual is responsible for in the Oasis is matched to their capabilities and preferences, yes? How laid-back.
When a human gives a Doll an order, it is to be completed, and whether or not the Doll is capable of it is not factored in. "At all cost" is the mantra that a Doll must follow.
Of course, there'll be those like you who think for the Dolls instead. No, I don't mean to challenge that position of yours. That said, if you want to champion your own ideals, then you must have the strength to defend it.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text:
Before coming here, I was under the employ of StateSec. Every arrangement was for the sake of practicality, and there was nothing to get in the way of my work. Of course, that includes my hair. I possess abilities superior to that of other Dolls in combat and decision-making. Where long hair impedes others, it only adds to the distinction of my results.
What, are you surprised by the lack of modesty on my part? Compared to humility, I would do better to recognize where exactly I stand, and not disparage myself. Besides, you chose me because I am strong, no?

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text:
Who...!
Oh... it's you, <cmdr>. Seriously, for me to fall asleep here. Even if it is downtime, I cannot allow myself to neglect the fundamental alertness required in my line of work. I ought to keep my guard up, especially when you are around.
Not to say that the Oasis is a dangerous place, but professional standards must be maintained. Everyone gathered at the Oasis has their own field within which they specialize, and if I fail to display what makes me unique, then I run the risk of being superseded by others. Pure strength is not irreplaceable, wouldn't you agree?

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text:
Life at the Oasis here is good. Other than what is necessary for work, I've learned some new things. The things that could never have been gleaned in the fires of a real battlefield, such as how to steady yourself and truly relax.
There's no need for you to worry, <cmdr>. An area within my neural module continually reminds me, "Clukay is here for you." The methods of relaxation and those reminders will not impact my capabilities in the slightest. On the contrary, they make me stronger to protect you, and for victory.

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
What are you looking for? Have you become used to my immaculate systemization of materials, and now struggle to readjust to the way others organize data?
Hmph... exactly as I expected. The more exceptional my work, the more recognition you bestow. Ergo, I'll be taking care of all your assignments and needs. Whether it be something others can or cannot do, I'll still get it done.
This is no coddling, but rather creating the best conditions I can for you. I promised you as much on my first day here, no?
I will not leave you without choices. I will only continue to be your best choice, <cmdr>.

voices.label: Dissatisfied
voices.text: Huh!?

voices.label: Laugh
voices.text: Hah...

voices.label: Surprised
voices.text: Huh!?

voices.label: Live2D
voices.text: "Professor"? That's how I should address you, right?

voices.label: Live2D1
voices.text: So you must not share this with anyone else, understand?

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: Come... bestow glory unto me.

voices.label: Live2D3
voices.text: Who...! Phew... it's you.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Producer. This is today's training schedule and this is today's performance schedule. This is the upcoming itinerary and this is... a leisure and costume change schedule? When did you put that in?

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: Tonight's live show is about to begin... I'll let you handle backstage support as usual. Every show will be perfect with your guidance. Now I shall show everyone what it means to dominate the stage, so just sit back and watch.

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: The show went off without a hitch. Thank you very much, Producer. Would you like an encore? Well, if it's just for you... then think of it as a special form of fanservice.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: I'll work twice as hard to claim the Idol★Live grand championship... Hm? You want to know why I set such a goal? That's probably because you mentioned it, no? You can't hide your expectant eyes from me. I'll take first place, even without an order from you.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: No producer of mine ought to be fascinated by someone else's songs. I am the only one worth your attention.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Are we moving on to the next show? I'm ready.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: You want me to strike a pose? Hm... How about "Love"?

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: Producer... You don't "adjust" the others' clothes like this, do you?

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Leave it to me.

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Is this my new mission? I see. I will become the most perfect idol there is. I'll be in your care then, Producer. Hm, you're questioning my form of address? Surely that's essential if I'm to be an idol, no?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: The show is about to begin.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: Listen to my song!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: MAGRASEA ATTACK!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: How's that? Did my performance have the desired effect?

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: But of course!

voices.label: Live2D2
voices.text: Listen up! ♪Restless night, still feels like it's frozen in time♪

voices.label: Live2D3
voices.text: ♪Just like a scab that won't heal, the wound still fresh, the pain so real♪ How's that? Was that the effect you were going for?

voices.label: Live2D4
voices.text: ♪Restless night, still feels like it's frozen in time♪

voices.label: Live2D5
voices.text: (♪Exciting music playing♪)

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning, Professor. Let's get some work done while the sunlight isn't too dazzling. What? You're not up yet? Honestly... Take my hand, time to get up.

voices.label: Good afternoon
voices.text: Do you need to cool down, Professor? Exercising in the afternoon uses up lots of stamina, so this will help keep you in your best state. I've got an energy drink here for... Ah, that can of beer isn't it...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: At this hour, even the waves have calmed down. Now, it's easy for me to pick up on the sound of the water or your breathing when you approach me, Professor.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: This is a water gun modified for swimming pools. The pressure is just right, it's got a large capacity, and it won't affect my mobility either. Such powerful equipment suits me, right? Humph... You've got that sneaky look on your face again.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: You really are relaxed, aren't you... Still, vacations like this aren't exactly commonplace, so you should be relaxing. I'll protect you.

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: You want to see my modified underwater modules? No problem, come this way.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Bring more water bombs next time. What we have now isn't enough.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: You want to have a water fight with me? Alright, I get it.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: Honestly, why does this waterproof coating have to be applied in such an inefficient way... Professor, could you help me apply some to my back?

voices.label: Acquisition
voices.text: Planning for a water battle? Then you should bring me along. Even if it's just a water fight, I won't let my team lose. I take it that's a yes, then?

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Time for a fight? No problem.

voices.label: Start Combat
voices.text: Feel the power of water guns!

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: Your luck has run out!

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: I'm used to it.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: I'll pay this humiliation back twofold!

career:
NSP is a Doll with "no affiliation", rarely seen in the Oasis. As NSP was not capable of providing materials related to her creation, the responsible personnel were not able to track down who exactly manufactured her and what her purpose was. As determined by the combined inspection of the Oasis Security and Medical Departments, NSP is equipped with massive amounts of arms modules, and displays balanced combat capabilities along with truly exceptional neural stability. In repeated combat trials, NSP passed with flying colors, displaying reaction speeds and the ability to react to sudden changes in circumstances far beyond that of conventional Dolls, and has thus been evaluated to be a special model, developed for military use as an elite unit.

Aside from any affiliated company, the exact reason and time of NSP's upload to Magrasea is also unclear. What one can be certain of, however, is that NSP was not originally planned to be a part of Project Neural Cloud.
infoStories:
To the entirety of the Oasis, Clukay is without a doubt a mysterious entity. During the registration process, a meeting was convened, and the Professor ended up filing her under the name of Svarog Heavy Industries. This decision appears to have been made due to the strong associations between the purpose of her design and the military-industrial complex, but what links exist between Clukay and Svarog Heavy Industries remain unknown.

After joining the Oasis, Clukay's performance in combat received universal appraisal from the Dolls there. Whether it be head-to-head engagements or special operations, Clukay accomplished her objectives excellently, and is without a doubt a multi-faceted combatant. Not only has Simo of the Security Department reached out to her, even Python admitted that she was a "formidable opponent."

This walking riddle of a Doll occasionally shows a cold and utilitarian side. Based on conjecture, her previous working environment may have included assignments such as scouting, assault, eradication of armed threats and similar operations. Whatever her occupation, it was deeply embroiled within the special information networks of criminal groups, black market conglomerates, spy safehouses, and such. Rumors say that Clukay's model never had operational limits, thus could kill humans in their operations—under the assumption that such measures were necessary, of course.

These clues in regard to Clukay's professional career all pointed directly towards the battlefield, and what position she occupied exactly sparked a wave of speculation in the Oasis. Clukay herself has only made clear her current line of work—"A mercenary."

No matter where exactly Clukay came from, her existence caused an inevitable nervousness in those of a more gentle disposition for a while. Clukay was not only inexorable and striking in combat, she also upheld a strong sense of responsibility in the completion of all other tasks, even if said task was only a simple matter.

Back when Clukay was new to the Oasis, many Dolls were subconsciously put on edge by her, but things soon returned to normal soon enough. To be swept up in that intense presence was truly exhausting, even if she herself never intended to exude that effect. This situation continued until the medic, Helix, fell over in front of her eyes. Clukay was a bit befuddled at the time, but quickly helped her up. Before she took even a few more steps, the girl tumbled over yet again.

"...Are you having a malfunction?" Clukay asked with good intentions, but the already distraught girl only seemed to become more despondent. After an extended and strenuous conversation, Clukay came to terms with it all—not every Doll here possesses rounded abilities in every field, or outstanding combat abilities like she does. Many unique cases of lacking ability in certain fields also exist and are accepted all the same.

As she met more and more Dolls who required help in their own ways, Clukay finally came to accept the previously inconceivable truth. As for the inhabitants of the Oasis, "Which planet of omnipotent Dolls does Clukay come from" became a hot topic of discussion.

After a lengthy period in each other's company, everyone began to see the other side of her beneath her cold and stoic exterior. As opposed to feeling any sense of belonging to the Oasis, her stance on the situation could be better described as a unique experience, but she still looked forward to returning to the world. Even if companionship would only be temporary, Clukay did not grow disconnected from the rest of the group: straightforward criticisms, cutting mockeries, and an almost ungraspable sliver of care. She was like to that to everyone.

Even if sometimes her words are overly acute, she has never hesitated to help and guide other Dolls. She possesses an exceptionally wide and rich knowledge base, almost to the point of appearing omniscient. Perhaps because of her very occupation as a "mercenary", she knows a variety of unscrupulous matters like the back of her hand, and one cannot help but guess at what fields of work she's ventured in the past.

As a police unit, Evelyn denied the speculation of "intelligence personnel", reasoning that some of the techniques Clukay uses overlaps with some of the special military police training she once received. She made some bold guesses, perhaps involving real intel, but Clukay never gave a clear answer. As for what exactly came to pass, only those two Dolls, between their brief conversations, will know.

After becoming more familiar with the bunch, Clukay started to be a frequent invitee of leisure activities around the Oasis. What is strangest to everyone, though, is Clukay's aversion to engaging in activities related to the drinking or sampling of alcohol, despite her appearing to be quite studied on the subject. It's as if alcohol was, to her, something that could only end badly if she made contact with it.

As understanding grows, so does the shroud of mystery thicken. If her behaviors in daily life would indicate that she was more in touch with the "present", her actions in operations outside of the Oasis shimmered with the shadows of the "past".

In an occasional cooperative outing, Clukay deftly placed a certain medic of small stature in a safe position. "I've been in charge of a few little guys like you before that needed some extra care... Though if we're talking about combat prowess, she was never one to fall behind anyone else." She watched as the girl in front of her took a deep blow, and frantically assured her of everyone's confidence in her medical capabilities, barely preventing the crestfallen medic from crying.

Clukay ran into no lack of obstacles on that assignment, with signals cut off, and reinforcements absent. Clukay displayed extreme resilience in the face of the situation, expertly distributing what operands were left and holding out until the very end with the help of medical assistance... as if she was once in such dire straits for eons on end. She began to intermittently think of the past, the silhouette of a lone figure arising between pieces and fragments of whispers.

The mission ended as the Professor arrived to take command, and the temporary squad was finally relieved by reinforcements. As victory dawned, Clukay displayed a series of extremely complex emotional impulses at the Professor's outreached hand.

"...To come here to the cloud for you is perhaps among one of the best the decisions I've made."

Clukay has never tried to hide her past acquaintance with the Professor, and to her the Oasis is simply where an inevitable reunion takes place. The past relationship between the two is veiled in the same mystery, and some Dolls even gossip that Clukay and the Professor have "special intimate names" between the two of them. No one has seriously questioned either of the two on this matter but differing speculations abound.

As for her true identity and personal history before being uploaded to the cloud, Clukay has remained silent. Everyone initially assumed that she held a strong disposition towards secrecy, but it was later discovered that this was perhaps not the whole picture. In order to maintain personal data security—mostly to prevent the possible leakage of classified intelligence, Clukay asked certain technical personnel to seal away a part of her own memories, most of them related to the Professor. 

It is also because of this special memory sectioning that Clukay's words and actions appear disjointed at times. Even if she displays an extent of familiarity and intimacy with the Professor, she feels disoriented in regards to her relationship with them, feeling an unparalleled trust in the Professor from within, as well as some other emotions sequestered deeper down.

Perhaps these mysteries will be revealed when we return to reality from the cloud.
oathDesc: You'll stay by my side forever... won't you?

projections.name: The Lost
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"I know not from whence I came, and now here I shall go. If it is to all repeat, then shall we have the same answer?"

projections.name: The Lost
projections.desc:
Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"I know not from whence I came, and now here I shall go. If it is to all repeat, then shall we have the same answer?"

projections.name: Dusky Overwatch
projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"I think I have my answer, Professor. Were I to go through that again hundred, a thousand times, you would remain my most trusted."

skinList.name: Leisurely Midday
skinList.desc:
The time was noon. Sunlight spilt amongst the greenery's appendages, the desire for an after-meal siesta mounting. Miss Crocodile appeared ever-so-quietly, extending an invitation to the Professor.
"Tired, are you? Naturally, you're a mess without me, Professor. Just leave everything to me from now on. Now, let's go get some coffee together.

skinList.name: Aflame Accent
skinList.desc:
Iridescent Musicale—Shining like a comet, descending on the horizon! This idol festival, a dazzling cornucopia, summons the roaring of countless spectators.
"As destiny would have it, here and now—hear my song!"

skinList.name: Raging Waves
skinList.desc:
Cerulean Hymnus—The azure waves stir one's thoughts, and the clear blue sky is a refreshing canvas. Write the verse that springs to mind with the rhythm of your heart and illuminate your long summer dreams.
Full speed ahead! It's a beautiful clear day, so let's keep going!
"Are you going to have a showdown on the waves? Why not bring me along? Even if it's just a water fight, you won't lose if you have me on your team. So it's agreed, then?"

skinList.name: Fool's Duality
skinList.desc:
True desires slip forth unwittingly as Dolls take on new forms with the help of mysterious powers. Reality and fiction interweave; take care to not be too absorbed in a fool's game.
""I think I've found the answer... the meaning of life lies in the habanera dance!""

skinList.name: Yes, Your Majesty
skinList.desc:
Crowned amidst countless cheers, she became a regal monarch. At the ceremony's end, she will help you clear away the intricate attire, and claim your exquisite reward. In this pillowed realm, strewn with strands of her, she is still at your command.
""Hmph... a mere cord is not enough to restrain a cat. Do not underestimate your Queen, so tell me, then. What would you have of me today? I shall make whatever it is reality.""
